scope: Diagnose cache-notice viewport ownership; repair a demonstrated scroll-restoration defect without changing browser assertions, visual baselines or restoration deadlines.

source.description: Explicit committed-base git archives with named overlays. Independent dirty Anthropic/provider/installed-consumer/documentary work is excluded and preserved. The prior interaction fixture correction is carried unchanged. The diagnostic browser probe is archived locally, not added to the application checkout.
source.webAndE2eDiffFromOriginalReceiptBase: No committed packages/web or e2e differences from bd058890b62dbaaac1ee8ba9ef3df0bd6021b6c0 before this increment.
source.exclusionReview: All missing paths match .dockerignore: docs, root Markdown/license/Makefile, two excluded Dockerfiles and two internal scripts. Included nested documentation is hashed normally.

diagnosis.existingCoverage: Nine existing helper cases cover bounded settling, virtual measurement and viewport adjustments, input retirement, unrelated offsets, detachment and disposal. They do not combine a new scroll with a simultaneous viewport-only resize. Existing cache and session browser journeys remain unchanged in the corrected candidate.
diagnosis.observation: A separate diagnostic copy attaches ResizeObserver/mutation/scroll geometry around the unchanged final cache viewport assertion. Both original cache journeys pass again. EN timeline shows scrollHeight 2259, initial scrollTop 0/clientHeight 634, then bottom scrollTop 1625, followed by clientHeight 683 and clamped scrollTop 1576. The jump-to-latest control disappearing changes the viewport by 49 CSS pixels.
diagnosis.defect: restoreWhileOwned previously treated every simultaneous viewport change as permission to reclaim an unrelated offset. A deterministic unit using the observed geometry makes the old helper restore scrollTop 0 thirteen times instead of retiring. A separate real Chromium root, importing the actual helper from the owning Vite host, reproduces viewport ratio 0 with the old helper and passes with the corrected helper.
diagnosis.correction: For viewport-only resizing, permit only offset shifts/clamping consistent with the viewport height delta, with one CSS pixel for rounded dimensions. Retire larger/opposite-direction scroll changes. Existing virtual measurement behavior when scrollHeight changes is retained.
newRegressionCases: A later bottom scroll survives simultaneous viewport growth.
An upward scroll during viewport shrink retires ownership.
Legitimate viewport clamping retains ownership and restores the captured position when the scroll range grows again.
diagnosis.unchangedControls: Ten settling frames, 120/300/600ms delays, input/identity disposal, assertion deadlines, retries, bundle budgets and all visual baselines are unchanged.
diagnosis.historicalLimit: The original complete-suite cache failure has no retained geometry proving this exact ordering. The full-context replay stops in mandatory CLI compilation before tests. The demonstrated helper defect is repaired; this is not proof that every cause of the original failure is eliminated.

environment.execution: Tests/types run only in Docker through Make-built images and Make E2E targets, in isolated inputs. Existing main-checkout test-results are never cleaned.
